_readme: Text for Tracker's 1cacba9 bugs 1, 3 and 4. No new facts or mechanics.

bug1_gossipPhrases._rule: Match on the fact id's path after runId. Use the line, filling {pride} with the pride name taken from the path. If nothing matches, DROP the gossip beat entirely. Never fall back to the raw id or to fact.summary (summaries are in second person). This applies to both followups.js gossipFact and lone-actions.js speakableFact.
bug1_gossipPhrases.ford_dispute/*: There was trouble at Greywater Ford. A Highcrag cat and a Bonefield cat got into it over a carcass in the water.
bug1_gossipPhrases.player_aided_bonefield: Word is some loner helped a Bonefield cat drag a kill out of the ford, right in front of Highcrag.
bug1_gossipPhrases.ford_choice/help_bonefield_cat: Word is some loner helped a Bonefield cat drag a kill out of the ford, right in front of Highcrag.
bug1_gossipPhrases.player_sided_highcrag: Word is some loner stood with Highcrag at the ford.
bug1_gossipPhrases.ford_choice/side_with_highcrag: Word is some loner stood with Highcrag at the ford.
bug1_gossipPhrases.player_stayed_out_ford: I heard some loner kept out of it at the ford and let them sort it out. I can't decide if that's clever or cowardly.
bug1_gossipPhrases.ford_choice/stay_out: I heard some loner kept out of it at the ford and let them sort it out. I can't decide if that's clever or cowardly.
bug1_gossipPhrases.hunt_steal/{pride}: Somebody's been stealing from {pride} kills, and {pride} is furious about it.
bug1_gossipPhrases.pride_aid/{pride}: Some loner walked a lost {pride} cub all the way home. {pride} is still talking about it.
bug1_gossipPhrases.scout/{pride}/*: {pride} cats say some loner's been up on the ridges, watching their border.
bug1_gossipPhrases.encounter/encounter.wolf_pack.v1/first_s: The wolves are on the move. Somebody saw a whole pack, and close by.
bug1_gossipPhrases.ford_dispute/*.knows: You were at Greywater Ford when Highcrag and Bonefield squared off over that carcass, weren't you? Everyone's talking about it.
bug1_gossipPhrases.player_aided_bonefield.knows: So it was you who helped Bonefield drag that kill out of the ford, with a Highcrag cat standing right there.
bug1_gossipPhrases.ford_choice/help_bonefield_cat.knows: So it was you who helped Bonefield drag that kill out of the ford, with a Highcrag cat standing right there.
bug1_gossipPhrases.player_sided_highcrag.knows: So you stood with Highcrag at the ford. Word gets around.
bug1_gossipPhrases.ford_choice/side_with_highcrag.knows: So you stood with Highcrag at the ford. Word gets around.
bug1_gossipPhrases.player_stayed_out_ford.knows: I heard you stayed out of that fight at the ford. I'm still not sure what I think about that.
bug1_gossipPhrases.ford_choice/stay_out.knows: I heard you stayed out of that fight at the ford. I'm still not sure what I think about that.
bug1_gossipPhrases.hunt_steal/{pride}.knows: Somebody's been stealing from {pride} kills. Funny thing, the thief they saw looked a lot like you.
bug1_gossipPhrases.pride_aid/{pride}.knows: So it was you who walked that lost {pride} cub home? {pride} still hasn't stopped talking about it.
bug1_gossipPhrases.scout/{pride}/*.knows: Word is you've been up on the ridges, watching the {pride} border.
bug1_gossipPhrases.encounter/encounter.wolf_pack.v1/first_s: So you ran into the wolf pack. Keep well clear of them.

bug3_scoutStanding._rule: Replaces lone-actions.js:584 `${name}'s standing toward you is ${standing}.` Pick by standing, using the same thresholds as the code. The number can go on the result line if Tundra wants it shown.
bug3_scoutStanding.high_ge_15: The {pride} cats on the border hardly bristle at your scent. You're not a stranger to them now.
bug3_scoutStanding.middle: The {pride} cats on the border don't seem sure what to make of you yet.
bug3_scoutStanding.low_le_minus_15: Any {pride} cat on that border would chase you off on sight.

bug4_slice.meeting.loner._rule: Replace the single sociability-baseline speech beat with these five. Middle sociability with high or low boldness gets its own line. Middle sociability with middle boldness then splits by aggression, so exactly one greeting plays.

beats.text: "Just you, then." {catName} looks you over, unhurried, from ears to bobtail. "Good. I don't like being outnumbered on my own trail."
"Are you…" {catName} swallows and tries again, quieter. "Are you on your own? I don't want any trouble."
"Just you?" {catName}'s tail lashes once. "Then you've got no one to blame if you put a paw wrong out here."
"Just you?" {catName} glances past you at the empty trail. "Or is someone following you?"
"Just you? Me too." {catName}'s shoulders ease a little. "There's room on this trail for two, if neither of us makes a fuss."

bug4_curiosity_tail.text: Where did you come from, anyway? Nobody just turns up out here.
bug4_curiosity_tail._note: Optional last beat, after the greeting. It plays for any loner with curiosity >= 70.
